panels.a_b: Unmodified measured populations; lightly smoothed mean-centered fits
panels.c: Same smoothed center traces as a/b; MHz converted to kHz
panels.d: Unsmoothed accepted Gaussian FWHM and Bloch reference divided by Gamma_T2

display_smoothing.method: Gaussian filter, sigma=1 amplitude sample, truncate=3, nearest edges
display_smoothing.gaps: Filter contiguous accepted runs independently; retain gaps
display_smoothing.scope: Center traces in a/b/c only; raw fits and reported RMS unchanged

limitations: Beta and midpoint smoothing both differ between measured runs.
These are selected settings, not beta-optimization sweeps.
No paired experimental and simulated beta sweeps found locally.
The Bloch reference uses the primary qubit coherence calibration.
